detail: D1-accept handler posts event 0x4F to FFAAE0 (ONLY poster of 0x4F in image)
same handler sets control-machine state FF8183 = 8
tone sequencer tick reads FFAAE0 (event id)
0x4F is a "restart/high-priority" beep event (one of four)
phase 0 (sub_384C2) starts tone, sets FFAAE8=1/2/3; note engine runs
FFAAE8 cleared to 0 when tone script terminator (0x25) reached
USB state 8 spins: while FFAAE8!=0, return w/o status ZLP (D1 NAKed)
once FFAAE8==0: arm EP0 status ZLP, advance -> state 9 (UPLOAD)
